name: Kairos
blurb: Kairos is a modern looking and intuitive to use calendar.
description:
Kairos is a modern looking and intuitive to use calendar. It's touch friendly usage makes it ideal for tablets.

Main features:

• Sync remote calendars from Gnome Online Accounts

• Manage existing calendars

• Display, add, modify and delete events

• Different calendar visualization modes

• Trackpad gestures for navigation

• Touch friendly input fields

• Search-Provider integration

• Add new events via Gnome-Search

• Mini-Mode as opt-in feature to stick Kairos to the desktop

• Collaboration as opt-in feature to share events and see information about invitations
